transforms.geometry_policy: Only complete closed ways; multipolygon relations not requested. Whole intersecting ways retained. Overlapping edge footprints retained for renderer clipping. Separate rings grouped into MultiPolygon features by layer/class/name. No invented geometry.
transforms.building_filter: Exclude no/shed/garage/garages/roof/carport/ruins and structures smaller than65m². Approximate planar area is only a visual filter.
transforms.simplification: Initial0.000008° then0.000018° Douglas–Peucker per closed ring, approximately1–2m. Second pass rejected if area changes by15% or more. Coordinates rounded to5decimals.
transforms.privacy: Only public geometric footprints and general building class; no addresses, owner/occupant names, contributor metadata. Names retained for public green/water features only.
transforms.scope: Opening-only scenic context; not used for routing, residents, shelters or emergency calculations.
